// comment: Places, and the projects and datasets within them, shown on the index map. Run `npm run collect` to refresh data/projects.json, data/datasets.json and data/places.json. Each place has an id, a name and optionally an "acknowledgement" of the peoples in whose territories it lies, shown once beneath the projects or datasets listed under it; the map outlines it with the boundaries of the projects (or, in the Data section, datasets) within it, and the Projects and Data pages list them beneath it. A project is an object holding its repository URL as "repo", the id of its place as "place", and optionally a "siteUrl" for a site that is not at the usual /story address, a "title" overriding the one taken from its description, and a "description" overriding the description itself. A project or dataset may instead be held in this repository, as an object with "dir" naming its folder - holding project.md or dataset.md and, optionally, boundary.geojson - and "siteUrl" giving where it links to. A place may also name an "island" in the islands KML ("islandsFile"), whose outline is drawn for it. A dataset may list tabular Darwin Core "occurrences" files, held as is, whose records are assigned to places by island and drawn on the map in the Data section - run `npm run occurrences` (see scripts/build-occurrences.js). A dataset published through GBIF may name its Darwin Core Archive occurrence file, kept out of git, as "sites": {"archive": ...}, to be summarised into one point per sampling site.

projects.title: Flora of Átl’ḵa7tsem/Howe Sound
projects.description: A map-based report on the vascular plant diversity of the Átl’ḵa7tsem/Howe Sound Biosphere Region, drawing on historical collections and community science observations to relate the region’s plants to biogeoclimatic zones and protected areas, map their status, track species that have not been reported in recent decades, and recognise the contributors whose records make this work possible.

projects.title: Flora of W̱SÁNEĆ/Saanich Peninsula
projects.description:
An analysis of the vascular plant flora of the Saanich Peninsula, drawing on historical collections and
community science observations to map the status of the region's plants, track species that have not been
reported in recent decades, and recognise the contributors whose records make this work possible. This work builds on the foundation of Harvey Janszen's revisions of Szczawinski and Harrison’s (1972) *Flora of the Saanich Peninsula* through ongoing data curation involving a community of naturalists in the Salish Sea.
